newsitem.title: ISRAEL: At least one Arab dead, 200 wounded in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: At least one Arab dead, 200 wounded in West Bank.

text.p: Israeli troops shot dead at least one Palestinian on Wednesday in the bloodiest clashes in the West Bank since PLO rule began in 1994, a hospital official said.
"There is one confirmed dead, but there may be as many as four dead," the administrative director of Ramallah hospital told Reuters. "There are more than 200 wounded."
A doctor showed reporters the uniformed body of a Palestinian youth dead of a gunshot wound to the eye.
Witnesses said Israeli troops shot the youth in Ramallah, where soldiers opened fire on demonstrators near a checkpoint on the border of the self-rule enclave.
